about_the_game:
Select a flagship and embark on a journey across a universe on the brink of annihilation. Construct a deck of ships and science, obtain powerful artifacts to enhance your strategy, and make tough choices for the good of the galaxy. Warp across sectors, battle hostile factions, and face impossible odds as the universe itself collapses around you.

In Ace of Space you take the roll of Flagship Commander on a desperate mission to save the galaxy from an all-consuming cosmic entity. With each sector you enter, you’ll encounter distinct factions, from the ruthless Sovereign Imperium to the elusive Venom Syndicate and the nature-bound Verdant Dominion. The stakes are high, and every choice you make could be your last.

But there’s more than just war—time and space are unraveling, and an ancient, unstoppable force is at the heart of it all. Will you attain the strength and synergies needed to stop the Oblivion Nexus, or will you and your crew be lost to the void?

Features:

  • Fight: Play cards to construct units, deal damage, and apply status affects to turn the tide of battle against enemies from across the galaxy. Adapt to each faction’s unique strengths and weaknesses. Control time and zoom in to catch every explosive detail.

  • Evolve: Assemble a cohesive deck. Acquire artifacts that enhance your play style. Develop a strategy strong enough to conquer the Final Boss.

  • Explore: Each sector is controlled by a distinct faction with their own agendas, strengths, and hostilities. Fight, trade, or forge alliances with the Ironclad Cartel, Stormfront Collective, and more.

  • Unlock: Progress unlocks artifacts that strengthen future runs. Defeating a boss grants access to that faction’s starter deck. Each discovered card is added to the compendium.

  • 100+ Units

  • 80+ Artifacts

  • 150+ Cards

  • 9 different Factions to encounter and play as

  • 46 unique Events

The universe is crumbling, and only you stand between survival and total annihilation. Are you ready to face what comes next?

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04 LTS or similar
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.1 compatible, integrated graphics (Intel HD 3000 or similar)
  • Storage: 100 MB available space

  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo 2.0 GHz
